comments.author: relwin
comments.story: Port of Los Angeles says shipping volume will plummet 35% next week
comments.why: Long documentary with a product manager showing costs and margins under tariffs
comments.text: Gamers Nexus essentially produced a 3-hr doc on how changing tariffs affect the US computer industry: "The Death of Affordable Computing | Tariffs Impact & Investigation" [VIDEO] . Best part is having a product manager show a spreadsheet of costs and margins and explain in real terms ($$$) what tariffs do to their business.

comments.author: herdymerzbow
comments.story: When UPS charged me a $684 tariff on $355 of vintage computer parts
comments.why: Manufacturers break down costs and tariff impacts; amounts now outdated
comments.text: gamers nexus did a great (and very long) video on the impact of tariffs on US computer businesses. Some of the manufacturers went into quite a bit of detail breaking down their costs and how tariffs would render some products so unprofitable that they would cease to serve the US market. Not sure if it necessarily applies to a niche/low volume business, but the impacts on a larger business were eye opening: [VIDEO] tariffs have chopped and changed so much since this video that the specific tariff amounts mentioned are likely not accurate.
